missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Множество' is the neuter nominative subject. 'Огромное' is the agreeing neuter adjective, and 'звёзд' is a genitive plural it quantifies. A natural way to express a great number.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Множество' is the accusative direct object of 'задал'; neuter nouns match the nominative. 'Вопросов' is the genitive plural that it counts. A common quantity pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'из'. The preposition 'из' takes the genitive 'множества' to mean out of the set. 'Вариантов' is a dependent genitive plural. Useful for selection language.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject quantifying. 'Множество' is the nominative subject, governing the genitive plural 'ошибок'. 'В тексте' gives the location. A clean quantity-statement frame.

Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'с'. 'С множеством' uses the instrumental 'множеством' after 'с' to mean working with a large amount. 'Данных' is a dependent genitive plural. Useful for technical talk.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'благодаря'. The preposition 'благодаря' takes the dative 'множеству' to mark a favourable cause. 'Друзей' is a dependent genitive plural. A reusable thanks-to pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О множестве' uses the prepositional 'множестве' after 'о' to mean talking about many. 'Проблем' is a dependent genitive plural. Common in discussion.

Strategic focus: Nominative subject in the mathematical sense. 'Множество' is the neuter nominative subject meaning a set. 'Содержит' governs the accusative 'пять элементов'. Shows the technical meaning.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural object. 'Множеств' is the genitive plural meaning the sets whose properties are studied, modifying 'свойства'. 'Учёные' is the nominative plural subject. Practises the plural form.

missions.phrase: К множеству причин добавилась ещё одна.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative after 'к'. The preposition 'к' takes the dative 'множеству' to mark addition to a group. 'Причин' is a dependent genitive plural. Useful for accumulating reasons.
